interfaces.name: text
interfaces.constraints: Unicode Python string; empty input allowed. No coercion of missing values, case folding, normalization, transliteration, stemming or deletion. Caller resolves table missing-value policies before this operation.

interfaces.name: word_characters
interfaces.constraints: Explicit string whose code points form the word-run alphabet. Empty and repeated characters allowed; membership only matters. Must be disjoint from whitespace_characters. Caller preserves the same policy across training and inference and chooses it for the intended domain.

interfaces.name: whitespace_characters
interfaces.constraints: Explicit string whose code points form the whitespace-run alphabet. Empty and repeated characters allowed. No automatic Unicode whitespace expansion. Must be disjoint from word_characters; characters outside both alphabets become individual tokens.

interfaces.name: result
interfaces.constraints: Ordered list of nonempty string tokens; empty input returns an empty list. Consecutive word or whitespace code points form runs; all other code points are individual tokens. Joining tokens exactly reproduces the input. Code-point semantics are not grapheme or linguistic segmentation. Independent chunk tokenization may change run boundaries. Witness metadata gives bounds only, not an exact token-array shape.
